A '''male Human''' with [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] owned a pet store on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the height of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Contrary to many other shady businesses in the planet-wide [[City/Legends|city]], his was a perfectly legitimate and well-stocked store. The Human was reputed for managing his shop in an effective way. When the notorious [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] [[Lyrre T'enna]] collected information on Coruscant's animal life for a published version of her [[Lyrre T'enna's annotated field guide|field guide]], she encountered the shopkeeper. T'enna draw a picture of him in the company of the animals he sold, which included [[Voorpak/Legends|voorpaks]], [[Faa/Legends|faas]], [[Nuna/Legends|nunas]], [[Jakrab/Legends|jakrabs]], a [[Peko-peko/Legends|peko-peko]], a [[shaupaut]], and a [[greysor]].<ref name="WoSW" />

==Personality and traits==
An older man with silver hair and pale, wrinkled skin, the Human store owner had blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a double chin. On the portrait drawn by Lyrre T'enna, he had a gentle, meek smile. He was slightly overweight, and he [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] burgundy and blue [[Robe/Legends|robes]] with a front pocket big enough to accommodate a small voorpak. Unlike some of his fellow dealers who were outright immoral, that man had principles and worked effectively in a legal and regular manner.<ref name="WoSW" />
